blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: When correcting an error, identify the incorrect assumption precisely; a bare True/False is weak diagnostic evidence.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: Connect each correction to a worked example: HTTPS versus phishing, paging versus remote files, key joins versus unmatched rows.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Show transfer by applying the rule to a different problem without being prompted by the original misconception.
